cleavage_agent: samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
enrichment_method: prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
fractionation_method: the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
instrument: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
labeling: inferred: this corresponds to a site with 4 spectral counts observed in one tissue and zero in all others.
mass_analyzer: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
ptm: We identified 12,039 proteins, including 6296 phosphoproteins harboring nearly 36,000 phosphorylation sites.
